snippet.title: Caves of Rigel - VIC 20 (unexpanded)
snippet.description:
A simple dodge/collect game I wrote towards the end of 2024.  I never managed to get the game running well enough for NTSC machines so it is PAL only.

Download: https://aj-layden.itch.io/caves-of-rigel
